Category: Seen Gods

Primarily Practiced in: Small pockets worldwide

Espirian Domains: The Hells (Neferium)

Machian is an enigmatic, but prevalent sibling amongst the affairs of the Sophic Siblings. Their wool is a harbor of magic, drawn upon the myriad of powers that make up the Eternal Strife. They do not participate directly in the Eternal Strife, and neither do their followers, but they participate in their societies as a neutral being whose purpose is to facilitate sacrifice and mediate rituals. Many of Machian’s worshippers are those who live to serve, and live to give themselves – even their lives – to a goal, no matter what it may be. The act of sacrifice is often more important than anything else – and indeed, Machian provides his blessing of bountiful magic to meet whatever end and ensure every ritual succeeds so long as a price is paid. Machian finds purchase in communities that participate in many rituals. For these, the Sheep of Joyous Sacrifice or their followers, encourage these rites to be as costly as imaginable. The more you give, the more Machian enjoys it – even if that means the altar is spilled with the blood of hundreds.

Title Sheep of Joyous Sacrifice

Edicts Pay more than what is required in all things, partake and provide during rituals     

Anathema Meet only what is expected of you, let others pay your toll in place of yourself

Areas of Concern Rituals, Sacrifice, Altruism

Religious Symbol Copper-colored fleece

Sacred Animal Sheep

Sacred Colors red and copper
